title: Left F119 2D Vectoring Nozzle Internal Flaps
summary: Variable-geometry convergent-divergent upper and lower flaps actuated by FADEC for +/-20 degree pitch thrust vectoring.
role: Varies throat/exit area for supercruise vs afterburner and vectors exhaust pitch up to +/-20 degrees.
materials: High-temperature titanium and ceramic thermal-barrier-coated flaps.
